name: Samantha Mahurin
bio: Samantha Mahurin was born on June 21, 1999. She is an actress, known for The Prestige (2006), Days of Our Lives (1965–) and The Young and the Restless (1973—).

credits.title: The Prestige
credits.overview: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy -- full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.
